title: iOS App Build
meta: A native iPhone and iPad app built in Swift, tested on real devices, inside your own Apple developer account. From $400, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: iOS app development, from idea to App Store launch
overview: We design and build a native iPhone and iPad app in Swift and SwiftUI. We agree the screens and features in writing, then build, test on real devices and prepare the app for the App Store inside your own Apple Developer account. You see working builds through TestFlight as we go, and you receive the full source code at handover. Apple makes the final call on approval.

faq: Do I need my own Apple Developer account?
Yes. The app is built and published under your account, so you own it. Enrollment is billed by Apple. We guide you through setup and ask you to add us as a team member, never to share your password.
Apple decides, not us. We build to the App Review Guidelines and prepare the listing, privacy details and review notes carefully. If Apple asks for changes, we help you respond.
You do. At handover you get the full Xcode project and source code, plus notes on how to build it. Third-party libraries keep their own open-source licences, which we list for you.
Standard and Premium connect to one backend or API that you already have, or to a simple hosted service such as Firebase. Building a large custom backend is a separate quote.
